overview_description.description: Aura is an information technology company dedicated to creating a safer internet for everyone. People are doing more online than ever, but as our lives get more connected, it's hard to know what’s safe. Aura believes people should be able to live their digital lives with peace of mind. Its mission is to create a safer internet by making comprehensive digital security simple to understand and easy to use so everyone can stay safe online.

about_short_description.short_description: Aura provides AI-powered security solutions that offer identity theft protection, credit monitoring, and online privacy for individuals.

product.name: Aura Digital Safety Plans
product.description: Subscription-based digital protection for individuals and families covering identity theft, financial fraud, privacy, online threats, devices, and family safety across supported devices.

product.name: Identity Theft Protection
product.description: Monitors personal information for signs of identity misuse and provides alerts, fraud resolution assistance, and eligible identity theft insurance coverage.

product.name: Credit Monitoring with Credit Lock
product.description: Monitors credit activity across Experian, TransUnion, and Equifax and provides alerts for potential fraud, with an Experian credit-file lock option.

product.name: Online Data Removal
product.description: Helps remove personal information from data brokers, people-search websites, and certain online search results to reduce unwanted exposure.

product.name: Suspicious Transaction Alerts
product.description: Monitors linked banking and retirement accounts for unusual transactions and alerts members to activity that differs from expected spending patterns or locations.

product.name: Aura VPN
product.description: Encrypts internet connections, helps protect users on public or private networks, blocks known scam and phishing sites, and provides more than 100 virtual locations.
